title: Decoding Dark Matter: Specialized Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Rare Concepts in Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating profession classification performance on the Bias in Bios dataset by using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to identify and ablate spurious gender-related features (e.g., gendered pronouns and names) via the SHIFT method, measuring the resulting improvement in worst-group accuracy across genders.
